job.title: Registered Nurse Contract
job.description:
Registered Nurse – Remote Hospital Locum | Flights + Accommodation Paid | Remote QLD

Fancy a nursing adventure in remote Queensland?
Surematch is looking for Registered Nurses for short locum contracts at a remote community hospital in Queensland. No full ED experience needed. If you’ve got hospital experience and a current ALS, we’d love to hear from you.

What’s in it for you:

  • Competitive locum rates
  • Return flights and accommodation covered
  • Flexible short contracts, from 2 weeks
  • Meaningful work with a remote community

What you’ll need:

  • Current AHPRA registration as an RN
  • Acute hospital experience
  • Current ALS

Keen? Apply now or call Gemma on 07 2141 1509 for a confidential cha
